# Common Parcel

> HOA software for volunteer boards and self-managed condominium associations.

Common Parcel brings dues, financial records, governing documents, meetings, and resident access together. The board remains responsible for decisions and review. The software is not a property management company or a provider of legal, accounting, or insurance advice.

## Product and company
- [Product](https://commonparcel.com/product): Capabilities and individual feature pages.
- [Pricing](https://commonparcel.com/pricing): Graduated monthly software pricing, with a $10 monthly minimum. The first 10 lots cost $2.50 each, lots 11–70 cost $1.10 each, and lots above 70 cost $0.40 each. Each rate applies only within its bracket.
- [Security](https://commonparcel.com/security): Payments, roles, approvals, and exports.
- [About](https://commonparcel.com/about): Independent software designed and built in Detroit by Jesse Bruner.
- [Contact](https://commonparcel.com/contact): Contact the founder directly.
- [App](https://app.commonparcel.com): Get started or sign in.

## Board resources
- [Board guides](https://commonparcel.com/blog): Practical articles and checklists. Legal guides include primary citations and retrieval dates. These are educational resources, not legal advice.
- [Privacy](https://commonparcel.com/privacy)
- [Terms](https://commonparcel.com/terms)

## Conditions
Online payments require a connected payment service and may carry separate processing fees. Common Parcel does not hold HOA funds. Postal mail is outside the software subscription; its price has not been set and certified-mail service is not connected. Document answers should be checked against the original source. Illustrations on the marketing site use sample information.
